Essays by Alessandro Gentili

Essay 08 · Il costo della complessità (in Italian)

Interpretive connection. The essay examines a common language reduced to slogans. Cicero’s relation between eloquence and wisdom offers a way to question the conditions of public speech capable of sustaining judgment.

Essay 16 · La pace senza forma (in Italian)

Direct reference. The essay invokes De re publica and De legibus to reflect on mixed government, law, citizenship and the durability of political order.
